annotations.title: Implied volatility from an option price

description: The Black-Scholes volatility at which the model value equals a given option price, or a message when no volatility fits that price. All inputs, including the interest rate and dividend yield, must be supplied.

dividend_yield_pct.description: Dividend yield per year in percent (0 is allowed).

option_price.description: Option price per share in dollars.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate per year in percent (0 is allowed).

name: implied_volatility
title: Implied volatility from an option price
